evidence_chain.quote: Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO) is a condition where excessive amounts of bacteria typically found in the colon are found in the small intestine and result in various gastrointestinal (GI) symptoms.

evidence_chain.link: The presence of SIBO in IBD patients may be due to various factors, including impaired intestinal mucosal integrity and intestinal stasis, which contrasts with the diagnosis of a gastrointestinal motility disorder (B2).
evidence_chain.quote: The underlying pathophysiology behind SIBO in IBD may be due to impaired intestinal mucosal integrity, intestinal stasis caused by strictures, and/or intra-abdominal adhesions and prior intestinal surgeries.
